title: Everything You Need to Know About Rhinoplasty in Baton Rouge
metaDescription: This can make the face look unbalanced. The procedure often performed to achieve a natural balance of the face by correcting the nose is called rhinoplasty.
html:
Unfortunately, we are not always born with the perfect nose to match our face. Often times the nose can be too small or too big, too wide or too narrow, or misshapen due to an accident. This can make the face look unbalanced. The procedure often performed to achieve a natural balance of the face by correcting the nose is called rhinoplasty. In Baton Rouge, men and women trust Dr. Hanemann at Hanemann Plastic Surgery to improve their nose and the way that they look.
What Is Rhinoplasty?
Sometimes referred to as a nose job, rhinoplasty is a surgery on the nose that changes the shape and sometimes its function. It can be cosmetic or be done for medical reasons to correct respiratory problems. During the procedure, your plastic surgeon will utilize an anesthesia that will sedate you for the duration of the surgery. While sedated, the surgeon will reshape the bone and cartilage to achieve the desired appearance.
Is Rhinoplasty Right for Me?
If you suffer from nasal defects or do not like the way that your nose makes you look, then you may be a great candidate for rhinoplasty. It is a very common procedure that has helped many people. The experts at Hanemann Plastic Surgery in Baton Rouge can perform a physical examination to determine the best course of action to have you looking and feeling your best.
What Can I Expect After Rhinoplasty?
After undergoing this nasal procedure most people find that they can go back to work in a short period of time, usually in only a week or two. People with more physical occupations may want to wait the full two weeks. It often depends on how comfortable you are with people seeing possible signs of the surgery, as to how soon you return to work. Dr. Hanemann can prescribe medications and instructions for during the mild recovery period.
Why wait for the nose that you have always dreamed of? You deserve to look your best and you deserve to feel confident. Contact the team at Hanemann Plastic Surgery in Baton Rouge to schedule your initial consultation today!
